mapper.insert: insert into workflow_run_context ( run_id, status, snapshot_json, created_at, updated_at ) values ( #{runId}, #{status}, #{snapshotJson}, now(), now() ) on duplicate key update status = values(status), snapshot_json = values(snapshot_json), updated_at = now()
mapper.select: select id, run_id, status, snapshot_json, created_at, updated_at from workflow_run_context where 1 = 1 and run_id = #{runId} limit 1
mapper.update: update workflow_run_context set status = #{status}, updated_at = now() where 1 = 1 and run_id = #{runId}
